text:
Source-assisted reading of F-1kdv (Gent, Universiteitsbibliotheek, HS.2583/243). All lines below were reread on the images by a research reader, first without and then with Krueger's text of Codex Iustinianus 7.62.31-32 and 7.65.8; the centre (gloss) panels and the cursive lines on fol. [2]v were not read.
Square brackets = supplied from the edition; (?) = uncertain; round brackets = abbreviation expanded. Boxes are native pixels x0,y0,x1,y1.

5  co]piam de(?)[negauerit
6  su]p(er)(?) hac(?) in(?)[iquitate   (cut through)
